### Homework 9

Row {data-height=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
"features/erik-l-2.json" |>  # Use your actual file from the corpus
  compmus_chroma(norm = "manhattan") |>  # Try different norms
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = pc, fill = value)) + 
  geom_raster() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 0:11,
    minor_breaks = NULL,
    labels = c(
                "C", "C#|Db", "D", "D#|Eb",
                "E", "F", "F#|Gb", "G",
                "G#|Ab", "A", "A#|Bb", "B"
              )
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = NULL, fill = NULL, 
       title = "Chromagram for erik-l-2",
       subtitle = "Harmonic content over time") +
  theme_classic()
```

Row {data-height=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
"features/erik-l-2.json" |>  # Use your actual file
  compmus_mfccs(norm = "euclidean") |>  # Try different norms
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = mfcc, fill = value)) + 
  geom_raster() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 0:12,
    minor_breaks = NULL,
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Coefficient Number", fill = NULL,
       title = "Cepstrogram for erik-l-2",
       subtitle = "Timbre features over time") +
  theme_classic()
```

Row {data-height=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
"features/erik-l-2.json" |>
  compmus_chroma(norm = "manhattan") |>
  compmus_self_similarity(
    feature = pc,
    distance = "aitchison"  # Try different distances
  ) |>   
  ggplot(aes(x = xtime, y = ytime, fill = d)) + 
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Time (s)", fill = NULL,
       title = "Chroma-based Self-Similarity Matrix",
       subtitle = "Comparing harmonic content across time points") +
  theme_classic()
```
